findings.message: <div id="s1"> is a timeline element that contains nested <div>. The timeline shows one row per top-level element, and the root composition is built only from sub-compositions.
findings.fixHint: Move <div id="s1"> and its contents into a sub-composition file and mount it with data-composition-src.

findings.message: Frame 0 shows only the background, and the first frame is the thumbnail on social players: have the title or key image already on screen at 0 s instead of entering from nothing; see references/review.md.
Nothing on screen changes for 3.13 s (14.38–17.50 s): start the next move within 3 s, or put data-hold on the element whose stillness is deliberate; see references/motion.md.
